nodes.label: Memory.__init__
nodes.desc: Reads MemoryConfig (configs/base.py), creates embedder/LLM/vector store/reranker via factories, opens SQLiteManager at config.history_db_path, and emits mem0.init telemetry.

nodes.label: Memory.add()
nodes.desc: add() builds filters via _build_filters_and_metadata (L314), rejects bad memory_type, normalizes messages, then either stores raw text or enters the V3 flow.

nodes.label: Memory.search()
nodes.desc: search() validates threshold/top_k (_validate_search_params L212), requires user_id/agent_id/run_id filters, processes advanced metadata operators, then calls _search_vector_store and optionally reranks.

nodes.label: get / get_all
nodes.desc: get(memory_id) fetches one vector payload; _get_all_from_vector_store (L1340) pages vector_store.list() under entity filters.

nodes.label: update() / _update_memory
nodes.desc: _update_memory (L2052) re-embeds the new text, rewrites vector + payload (fresh md5 hash, updated_at), logs UPDATE history and re-links entities when text changed.

nodes.label: delete() / delete_all
nodes.desc: _delete_memory (L2116) removes the vector, writes a DELETE history row with is_deleted=1 and unlinks the memory from entity records; delete_all loops list+delete in batches of 1000.

nodes.label: history()
nodes.desc: history(memory_id) replays the audit trail for one memory straight from SQLite - the debug window into every ADD/UPDATE/DELETE.

nodes.label: reset()
nodes.desc: reset() re-creates SQLiteManager, asks VectorStoreFactory.reset to drop the collection and clears the lazily-built entity store.

nodes.label: infer=False raw path
nodes.desc: When infer=False each non-system message is embedded verbatim and pushed through _create_memory (L1975): uuid4 id, md5 hash, lemmatized text, insert + ADD history.

nodes.label: Phase 0: context gathering
nodes.desc: Builds a session scope and pulls the last 10 turns from SQLite (get_last_messages) so the extractor sees running context, not just the new messages.

nodes.label: Phase 1: existing memory retrieval
nodes.desc: Embeds the conversation and searches the vector store for top-10 similar memories; ids are mapped to integer indexes so the LLM cannot hallucinate real UUIDs.

nodes.label: Phase 2: LLM extraction
nodes.desc: One generate_response call with ADDITIVE_EXTRACTION_PROMPT (configs/prompts.py L468) plus generate_additive_extraction_prompt (L1016); failures now raise LLMError instead of returning [] silently.

nodes.label: Phase 3: batch embed facts
nodes.desc: All extracted fact texts are embedded in one embed_batch call (individual embed as fallback), building an embed_map for the write phase.

nodes.label: Phase 4/5: hash dedup
nodes.desc: md5(text) skips facts already in the store or repeated inside the batch; survivors get uuid4 ids, created_at/updated_at and lemmatized text in the payload.

nodes.label: Phase 6: batch persist
nodes.desc: vector_store.insert in one batch (per-record fallback), then batch_add_history rows; only records the store actually accepted are reported as ADD.

nodes.label: Phase 7: entity linking
nodes.desc: extract_entities_batch() names entities; exact or >=0.95 semantic matches update linked_memory_ids in place, otherwise new entity vectors are batch-inserted.

nodes.label: SQLiteManager
nodes.desc: Opens (or migrates) the history table plus a messages table; created with ':memory:' default but usually config.history_db_path on disk.

nodes.label: add_history / batch_add_history
nodes.desc: Records memory_id, old_memory, new_memory, event, is_deleted with timestamps - the write-ahead log that history() reads back.

nodes.label: get_history
nodes.desc: SELECT over the history table ordered for one memory_id, returning the ordered event list.

nodes.label: save_messages / get_last_messages
nodes.desc: Per-session raw message cache: add() saves each turn (Phase 8) and the next extraction reads the last 10 (Phase 0).

nodes.label: _search_vector_store
nodes.desc: Nine steps from query preprocessing to MemoryItem formatting: lemmatize, entity extraction, embed, over-fetch (max(limit*4, 60)), keyword pass, BM25 normalize, entity boosts, score_and_rank.

nodes.label: lemmatize_for_bm25
nodes.desc: Normalizes inflections so BM25 keyword matching survives plurals and verb forms; stored alongside every memory as text_lemmatized.

nodes.label: extract_entities
nodes.desc: spaCy-backed NER with proper-name, quoted and technical-identifier candidate rules (extract_entities L751, extract_entities_batch L761); drives both entity boosts and linking.

nodes.label: embedding_model.embed(query)
nodes.desc: Query embedding with memory_action=search - shared by the search path and Phase 1 of add().

nodes.label: vector_store.search (dense)
nodes.desc: Semantic candidates from the over-fetched pool; expired payloads (expiration_date) are filtered unless show_expired.

nodes.label: vector_store.keyword_search (BM25)
nodes.desc: Sparse BM25 pass on stores that implement the keyword_search hook (VectorStoreBase L72); Qdrant encodes the query into its sparse 'bm25' vector.

nodes.label: _compute_entity_boosts
nodes.desc: Embeds up to 8 query entities, searches the entity collection (top 500, >=0.5 similarity) and boosts linked memories by similarity * 0.5 dampened by link count.

nodes.label: score_and_rank
nodes.desc: Threshold gates the semantic score first, then combined = (semantic + bm25 + entity) / adaptive max_possible (1.0-2.5); explain=True returns score_details.

nodes.label: reranker.rerank
nodes.desc: Optional RerankerFactory-built model (cohere, huggingface, sentence-transformer...) reorders survivors; failures fall back to the original ranking.

nodes.label: MemoryItem formatting
nodes.desc: Results are cast to the MemoryItem model (configs/base.py L16), promoted keys surfaced, extras tucked into metadata.

nodes.label: Llm/Embedder/VectorStore/RerankerFactory
nodes.desc: String-to-class registries (LlmFactory L35, EmbedderFactory L152, VectorStoreFactory L180, RerankerFactory L226) with register_provider() extension hook.

nodes.label: Qdrant backend
nodes.desc: create_col (L145) with dense + optional bm25 sparse slot, insert (L203), _create_filter (L356) for tenant scoping, search (L432), search_batch (L454), keyword_search (L471).

nodes.label: OpenAILLM.generate_response
nodes.desc: Wraps chat.completions.create with json_object response_format for extraction; OpenRouter and Azure variants live beside it.

nodes.label: OpenAIEmbedding
nodes.desc: text-embedding-3-small by default; embed (L37) for single texts, embed_batch (L57) chunks 100 inputs per API call.
